taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station H-03, survey area H. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 193.6 | 0.90 | 0.90
2 | 129.1 | 3.18 | 4.08
3 | 29.1 | 0.79 | 4.87
4 | 29.8 | 26.64 | 31.51
5 | 165.4 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as QHA-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station H-03, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Groundwater Site Note: Station H-03 (Survey Area H)**

Station H-03 presents a 5-layer geoelectric section:
- **Layer 1 (0.00–0.90 m):** 193.6 Ω·m (resistive topsoil)
- **Layer 2 (0.90–4.08 m):** 129.1 Ω·m (moderately weathered horizon)
- **Layer 3 (4.08–4.87 m):** 29.1 Ω·m (conductive layer)
- **Layer 4 (4.87–31.51 m):** 29.8 Ω·m (26.64 m thick main target aquifer zone)
- **Layer 5 (>31.51 m):** 165.4 Ω·m (resistive bedrock basement)

Evaluating the successive 3-layer intervals:
- Layers 1–3: $193.6 > 129.1 > 29.1$ (Q-type)
- Layers 2–4: $129.1 > 29.1 < 29.8$ (H-type)
- Layers 3–5: $29.1 < 29.8 < 165.4$ (A-type)

The sequence corresponds to a **QHA-type** curve, which matches the on-file classification.

{"curve_type_stated": "QHA", "label_issue_flagged": false}
